design_parameters.name: ADDR_W
design_parameters.description: Pointer width derived from DEPTH as $clog2(DEPTH); sets the width of wr_ptr and rd_ptr, which index the DEPTH-entry memory array and wrap modulo DEPTH.

design_parameters.name: CNT_W
design_parameters.description: Width of the count/occupancy value, derived as ADDR_W + 1 = $clog2(DEPTH)+1, so count can represent the full range 0..DEPTH including the full condition.

design_parameters.name: DEPTH_CNT
design_parameters.description: Constant representation of DEPTH sized to CNT_W bits; used to compare against count to generate the full flag (full = count == DEPTH_CNT).
